tasks.how: Go to Results and sort the feed by random to read a sample of mentions.
tasks.check: Sample read across the full date range.

tasks.task: Identify irrelevant posts and their cause
tasks.how: Identify the irrelevant posts in the sample and why they were collected.
tasks.check: Each noise group has a cause and example posts.

tasks.task: Check spam in the top authors
tasks.how: Go to Influencers and sort by number of posts.
Open each flagged account and check whether it publishes too much (spam).
tasks.check: Each flagged account has a keep / exclude decision with evidence; resellers stay in scope.

tasks.how: Build the exclusion from the irrelevant terms identified in phase 0.
tasks.check: Syntax valid; within 4,096 characters and 50 operands; terms that can appear in a watch post carry a guard.

tasks.task: Test the exclusion on the results page
tasks.how: Apply the exclusion on the Results page and check what it removes.
tasks.check: Before / after count on the same period; removed posts reviewed for false exclusions.

tasks.how: If the query is correct, add it to the exclusion section of the corresponding topic and save it.
tasks.check: Saved query read back and matches the approved version; change logged.

tasks.how: Go to the Results page and select the time period.
tasks.check: Explicit calendar dates used, not period presets.
tasks.output: Weekly volumes per tag, last 3 months

tasks.how: Check the evolution of the results to spot holes in the data.
tasks.check: Every gap is either explained (e.g. by a logged query change) or listed as unexplained.

tasks.how: If a lack of volume has been spotted, check that the tagging rule is still active (Talkwalker > Settings > Rules).
tasks.check: Rule active again; volume back on the next read.

tasks.how: Each month, read a sample of the posts each custom filter matched and flag filters picking up off-topic posts.
tasks.check: Precision estimated for every filter; drops vs last month flagged.
tasks.output: Precision estimate per filter + proposed fixes

tasks.how: Each month, look for new consumer vocabulary (new models, slang, hashtags) that the live filters miss.
tasks.check: Each proposed addition comes with the posts it would add.

tasks.task: Verify owned and paid account lists
tasks.how: Check that the author IDs used for owned voice and brand-account exclusions still point to the right accounts; add new official handles.
tasks.check: Every author ID confirmed; new official handles added.

tasks.task: Check word clouds and theme widgets
tasks.how: Open each dashboard widget and look for repeated or meaningless phrases.
tasks.check: No repeated or meaningless phrase left in the widgets.

tasks.how: Read a random sample per topic and correct mislabelled sentiment.
tasks.check: Every disagreement reviewed; mislabelled posts corrected.

tasks.how: After any query broadening, check project usage against the monthly quota.
Record the before / after query, reason, date and rollback for each saved change.
tasks.check: Every saved change has a log entry.
